changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO cbs_setting (setting_key, setting_value, description) VALUES ('iit_days', '28', 'Days without ARVs after the last refill ran out before a client counts as interrupted in treatment'), ('default_refill_days', '30', 'Days of drugs assumed when a pharmacy refill has no refill period recorded'), ('linkage_days', '30', 'Days after an HTS positive result before a missing HIV enrolment is flagged'), ('art_initiation_days', '30', 'Days after enrolment before a missing ART commencement record is flagged'), ('follow_up_days', '30', 'Days after an interruption before missing client tracking is flagged'), ('eac_days', '30', 'Days after an unsuppressed viral load before a missing EAC session is flagged'), ('vl_unsuppressed_copies', '1000', 'Viral load at or above this value (copies/mL) is unsuppressed'), ('alive_evidence_days', '365', 'A clinical contact within this many days counts as evidence the client is alive'), ('cross_module_tolerance_days', '7', 'Allowed difference in days when the same date is recorded in two places'), ('due_days_high', '7', 'Days to resolve a High severity issue'), ('due_days_medium', '14', 'Days to resolve a Medium severity issue'), ('due_days_low', '30', 'Days to resolve a Low severity issue'), ('stale_hours', '24', 'Show a stale data warning when the last successful refresh is older than this') ON CONFLICT (setting_key) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: dqr-cbs
changeSet.sql: UPDATE cbs_setting SET setting_value = '1', description = 'Days after the interruption date before missing client tracking is flagged (CBS-DQ-05)' WHERE setting_key = 'follow_up_days'; DELETE FROM cbs_setting WHERE setting_key = 'art_initiation_days'; INSERT INTO cbs_setting (setting_key, setting_value, description) VALUES ('vl_eligibility_months', '6', 'Months on ART before viral load results count for suppression, and the window in which a viral load sample is expected (CBS-DQ-19)'), ('vl_undetectable_copies', '50', 'Viral load below this value (copies/mL) is shown as Undetectable'), ('post_eac_vl_days', '180', 'Days after EAC completion before a missing confirmation viral load is flagged (CBS-DQ-21)'), ('cd4_baseline_days', '0', 'A CD4 sample up to this many days after ART start still counts as the baseline CD4 (CBS-DQ-26)'), ('entry_date_tolerance_days', '1', 'An event dated more than this many days after the record was entered is flagged (CBS-DQ-10)') ON CONFLICT (setting_key) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: dqr-cbs
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cbs_finding ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS event_date DATE; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cbs_finding_event_date ON cbs_finding (facility_id, event_date);
